I couldn’t pick a member that stood out the best for me, someone who stuck with me the moment i saw him, like maybe it’s because of my tenure in kpop that I pretty much looked forward to that one particular member as I normally do. I guess since they’re still young they’re also still on the way to finding their true selves as a performer and what kind of image they want the people to remember them of.

But anyway, It’s too early, they’re just starting I’m sure they’ll be able to give that missing piece eventually. Don’t get me wrong this is still SO GOOD.
